# ---- blackouts as phase bitmasks per link
        links = fb['links']
        self.L = L = len(links)
        bmask = [0] * L
        for rec in fb['blackouts']:
            l = int(rec[0])
            a = int(rec[1])
            b = int(rec[2])
            bmask[l] |= ((1 << (b - a)) - 1) << a
        self.bmask = bmask

        # ---- per link / direction tables
        n0 = [0] * L; n1 = [0] * L
        s0 = [0] * L; s1 = [0] * L
        g0 = [0] * L; g1 = [0] * L
        dl0 = [0] * L; dl1 = [0] * L
        q0 = [0] * L; q1 = [0] * L
        k0 = [0] * L; k1 = [0] * L
        pt0 = [0] * L; pt1 = [0] * L
        Hc = [0] * (2 * L)
        Cc = [0] * (2 * L)
        H = cal.H
        CO = cal.corr
        for l in range(L):
            lk = links[l]
            ends = lk['ends']
            e0 = ends[0]; e1 = ends[1]
            n0[l] = int(e0[0]); s0[l] = int(e0[1]); g0[l] = int(e0[2])
            n1[l] = int(e1[0]); s1[l] = int(e1[1]); g1[l] = int(e1[2])
            dn = lk['delay_ns']; dq = lk['defer_rounds']
            dl0[l] = int(dn[0]); dl1[l] = int(dn[1])
            q0[l] = int(dq[0]); q1[l] = int(dq[1])
            k0[l] = ceil_div(dl0[l], T); k1[l] = ceil_div(dl1[l], T)
            pt0[l] = k0[l] * T - dl0[l]; pt1[l] = k1[l] * T - dl1[l]
            Hc[2 * l] = H[g0[l]][g1[l]]; Hc[2 * l + 1] = H[g1[l]][g0[l]]
            Cc[2 * l] = CO[g0[l]][g1[l]]; Cc[2 * l + 1] = CO[g1[l]][g0[l]]
        self.n0 = n0; self.n1 = n1; self.s0 = s0; self.s1 = s1
        self.g0 = g0; self.g1 = g1
        self.dl0 = dl0; self.dl1 = dl1
        self.q0 = q0; self.q1 = q1
        self.k0 = k0; self.k1 = k1
        self.pt0 = pt0; self.pt1 = pt1
        self.Hc = Hc; self.Cc = Cc
        self.kmax = max([1] + k0 + k1)
        self.max_span = max([1] + [k0[l] + q0[l] for l in range(L)]
                            + [k1[l] + q1[l] for l in range(L)])
        # dirinfo[code] = (src, dst, slot_src, delay, k, defer, group_src, group_dst)
        di = [None] * (2 * L)
        for l in range(L):
            di[2 * l] = (n0[l], n1[l], s0[l], dl0[l], k0[l], q0[l], g0[l], g1[l])
            di[2 * l + 1] = (n1[l], n0[l], s1[l], dl1[l], k1[l], q1[l], g1[l], g0[l])
        self.dirinfo = di

        # ---- prefix sums of the waiting costs, extended past one period
        ext = P + self.max_span + 2
        self.mp = mp = [t % P for t in range(ext)]
        pc = []
        for i in range(N):
            e = effn[i]
            row = [0] * ext
            acc = 0
            for t in range(ext - 1):
                acc += e[mp[t]] * T
                row[t + 1] = acc
            pc.append(row)
        self.pc = pc

        # ---- window masks: phases touched by a flight of k intervals
        wmask = []
        full = (1 << P) - 1
        kmax = self.kmax
        for p in range(P):
            row = [0] * (kmax + 1)
            for k in range(1, kmax + 1):
                if k >= P:
                    row[k] = full
                else:
                    m = 0
                    for j in range(k):
                        m |= 1 << mp[p + j]
                    row[k] = m
            wmask.append(row)
        self.wmask = wmask

        # ---- slices actually sampled by some phase
        used = set(sl)
        self.slice_sets = {}
        for s in used:
            self.slice_sets[s] = set(int(x) for x in slices[s])
        self.slices = slices
